data.description:

Xiao-I Corp. ADR ( (AIXI) ) just unveiled an update.

On August 6, 2026, Xiao-I Corporation disclosed that it had received a written notice from Nasdaq’s Listing Qualifications Department stating that the company’s market value of publicly held shares fell below the US$15 million threshold required under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5450(b)(3)(C). The deficiency was determined based on the closing bid prices of Xiao-I’s American Depositary Shares over the 30 consecutive business days from June 23 through August 4, 2026.

The notification does not immediately affect the listing or trading of Xiao-I’s ADSs, which will continue to trade on the Nasdaq Global Market under the symbol AIXI while the company remains subject to other listing requirements. Nasdaq has granted Xiao-I a 180-day compliance period until February 1, 2027, during which its market value of publicly held shares must reach at least US$15 million for a minimum of ten consecutive business days to cure the deficiency.

If Xiao-I fails to regain compliance by the end of this period, its securities could face delisting from Nasdaq, with the company retaining the right to appeal any such determination to a hearings panel. Xiao-I said it plans to actively monitor its market value and evaluate options to restore compliance, underscoring potential risks for shareholders around listing status and liquidity if these efforts do not succeed.
